intro: Lhasa is the highest region on this site by a wide margin, and everything about the radio follows from that. At 3,650 metres the air is thin and bone dry, there is almost no industrial noise, and the surrounding ridges are another thousand metres above the valley floor. VHF here travels further than anywhere else in China, and shortwave reception is exceptional. It is also the region where a radio is most likely to be genuinely needed: distances between settlements are enormous, and mobile coverage ends quickly once you leave the valley.
introz: 拉萨是本站海拔最高的地区，而且高出其他地区很多，这里无线电的一切都由此而来。三千六百五十米的海拔上空气稀薄干燥，几乎没有工业噪声，周围山脊又比谷底高出上千米。这里的 VHF 传播距离是全中国最远的，短波接收条件也极为出色。这同时也是最可能真正需要一台电台的地区：聚落之间距离极大，一旦离开河谷，手机信号很快就没有了。

stations.d: Gonggar is one of the highest commercial airports in the world and approaches are flown down the valley. Worth listening to on a windy afternoon.
stations.dz: 贡嘎是全球海拔最高的商用机场之一，进近要沿河谷下降。刮风的下午很值得一听。

stations.n: No continuous weather radio in China
stations.z: 中国没有连续气象广播
stations.d: No continuous weather broadcast. At this altitude the weather changes within the hour, and the only real sources are the provincial traffic station and what you can see.
stations.dz: 没有连续气象广播。在这个海拔天气一小时内就能变，真正的信息来源只有省级交通广播和你自己的眼睛。

stations.z: 2 米 FM 呼叫频率（IARU 三区）
stations.d: The best VHF conditions in China. From a pass above the Kyichu a five-watt handheld reaches distances that are simply not possible at sea level.
stations.dz: 全中国最好的 VHF 条件。在拉萨河谷上方的垭口，五瓦手台能打出海平面高度根本不可能的距离。

stations.z: APRS 数据 · 一区与三区

stations.d: Tibet traffic radio carries pass closures and road conditions, which on the G318 and the G109 is the information that matters.
stations.dz: 西藏交通广播播报垭口封闭和路况——在 318 和 109 国道上，这才是要紧的信息。

stations.d: Almost no noise floor and a very high horizon. The night-time band here reaches into South and Central Asia.
stations.dz: 底噪几乎为零，视野高度极高。这里的夜间频段能覆盖到南亚和中亚。

stations.d: Every tour group, every guesthouse and every convoy on the road out of the valley runs 409 MHz.
stations.dz: 每个旅行团、每家客栈、每支出谷的车队都在用 409 MHz。

stations.d: On a self-drive route, agree a channel at the top of the band before you leave mobile coverage. This is the single most practical thing on this page.
stations.dz: 自驾时，在离开手机信号之前先约定一个高段信道。这是本页最实用的一条建议。

stations.n: 公安 350 MHz — encrypted PDT digital
stations.z: 公安 350 MHz · PDT 数字加密

stations.d: Thin dry air and no industrial noise. The Pucheng time station comes in cleanly on all four frequencies.
stations.dz: 空气稀薄干燥，没有工业噪声。蒲城授时台的四个频率都收得很干净。

stations.d: The best satellite reception in China, and it is not close. No noise floor, and horizon-to-horizon visibility from almost anywhere.
stations.dz: 中国最好的卫星接收条件，而且优势明显。没有底噪，在几乎任何地方都能看到地平线到地平线的全程。
